research_findings: Identified that the waitlist feature lacked rate limiting, exposing the system to potential spam and abuse before heavy traffic.
features_improved: Optimized waitlist signup action with Upstash Redis-based sliding window rate limiting.
new_features_added: Added resilient rate-limiting for user actions based on IP using @upstash/ratelimit with a fallback bypass.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement Upstash rate-limiting for other public-facing endpoints and AI evaluation routes.
